sentences.text: The court while directing issue of notice to the Respondents herein to show cause as to why this application Should not be complied with, made the following order.(The receipt of this order will be deemed to be the receipt of notice in the case).
The Court made the following ORDER Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Assistant Public Prosecutor.

Appellant/Accused No.7 is retired bank employee who suffered conviction for the charges under Section 13(1)(c) (d) read with 13(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 under Section 248(2)
of 'the Cr.P.C.,' and Section 120-B, 420 and 471 of'the I.P.C.,' on 23.12.2025.
^ver since Appellant has been in the judicial custody.
Appellant/Accused No.7 herein shall be enlarged on bail on his executing a bond for a sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) with two sureties for the like sum each to the satisfaction of the learned I Additional Special Judge for C.B.I.Cases, Visakhapatnam.
Sentence of imprisonment imposed by the learned I Additional Special Judge for C.B.I.Cases,
Visakhapatnam, vide order dated 23.12.2025 in C.C.No.18 of 2022 alone is suspended pending disposal of the Criminal Appeal.
